_note: The UK evidence map: one row per published figure on AI's economic effects, read from the primary text at `loc` on the `checked` date (`how`: 'read' = re-read in the primary text for this table; 'review' = confirmed in the 15 Nov 2026 UK-studies review, figures as in the literature comparison, PR #41). `value` is the figure as printed; `lo`/`hi`/`mark` are the same figure as numbers, for the 'Where our numbers sit' charts (RANGES in data/literature.js selects the rows with `plot`; rows sharing `join` draw as one bar). `none` = no number published; `unverified` = not confirmed in the published text. Each row is against its own `baseline`; OG-UK's figures are against the OBR-central path and come from surprise2028.json, not from this file. Figures on the review's 'keep off until checked' list are not here.
